blocks.heading: Clinical AI for Mass General Brigham
paragraphs: Mass General Brigham (MGH + Brigham + McLean + NSMC + Newton-Wellesley + Faulkner + Spaulding + others):

Patient risk stratification at system scale: ML for Mass General Brigham's 16+ hospital system — 30-day readmission, clinical deterioration, sepsis early warning, and length of stay prediction with Epic FHIR R4 integration across MGB's Epic deployment (one of the world's largest Epic implementations).
Clinical operations efficiency: OR scheduling optimization, ED throughput prediction, and staffing demand forecasting for MGB's high-volume academic and community hospitals.
Population health management: ML for MGB's substantial value-based care and accountable care organization programs — one of the most sophisticated VBC programs in US healthcare.
Cost: $65,000–$180,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + MGB governance

blocks.heading: Oncology AI for Dana-Farber and MGH Cancer Center
paragraphs: Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and MGH Cancer Center — two of the world's most productive cancer research programs:
Tumor response prediction: ML predicting tumor response to treatment from genomic, imaging, and clinical features for Dana-Farber's precision oncology programs.

Clinical trial patient identification: NLP and ML identifying patients who may be eligible for Dana-Farber's extensive clinical trial portfolio from Epic documentation — accelerating trial enrollment at one of the world's most active cancer research centers.
Radiation therapy optimization: ML for treatment planning optimization at Dana-Farber's and MGH's radiation oncology programs.
Cost: $70,000–$200,000 | Timeline: 14–30 weeks | HIPAA + IRB

blocks.heading: Pediatric Clinical AI for Boston Children's
paragraphs: Boston Children's Hospital — the world's most research-active children's hospital and consistently ranked #1 in the US for multiple pediatric specialties:

Pediatric risk stratification: ML models calibrated to pediatric physiology — not adult models with age adjustment, but genuinely pediatric-trained ML for the specific clinical patterns of neonatal, infant, child, and adolescent populations.
Rare disease identification: NLP identifying potential rare disease presentations from clinical documentation for Boston Children's Center for Rare Diseases.
Pediatric surgery scheduling: ML for Boston Children's high-complexity pediatric surgery scheduling and OR utilization optimization.
Cost: $70,000–$190,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + COPPA + IRB

blocks.heading: Digital Health and HealthTech
paragraphs: Boston's digital health ecosystem — WHOOP (Boston), Flatiron Health (NYC, accessible Boston market), and the MGB-adjacent startups commercializing Boston clinical AI research:
Remote patient monitoring AI for Boston's leading digital health companies.

sections.title: Boston Healthcare AI Research Standards

blocks.heading: IRB compliance
paragraphs: Boston's academic medical centers have IRB processes for research data access — clinical AI using de-identified patient data for research purposes requires IRB approval and data use agreements. ClickMasters designs Boston research AI within IRB frameworks and recommends qualified health research compliance counsel.

blocks.heading: Epic at Mass General Brigham
paragraphs: MGB's Epic implementation is one of the world's largest — ClickMasters designs AI with Epic FHIR R4 API integration, MGB's specific Epic configuration, and MGB's AI governance requirements.

blocks.heading: Clinical research publication standards
paragraphs: Boston's clinical AI often targets journal publication alongside clinical deployment — ClickMasters designs research AI with reproducibility, statistical rigor, and reporting standards appropriate for submission to NEJM, Lancet, and top clinical AI venues.
